significance.justification: A verified-true result would license the form-(iii) predictive coupling that residual-stream movement in an answer-encoding subspace—“belief-state velocity”—orders tokens by causal answer importance, with sustained near-zero velocity predicting convergence and safe early exit. This establishes both a behavioral phenomenon (low-velocity tokens are disproportionately inert) and a candidate mechanism (useful reasoning changes an answer-relevant internal state), constraining which tokens should survive compression and when computation should stop; this is weightier than the generic adaptive-compute premise used by CALM and LayerSkip because the stated relation links an independently measurable internal quantity to later causal effects. A verified-false result is distinguishable and informative, ruling out answer-subspace stationarity as a general account of reasoning inertness, although it would not rule out other internal importance signals. In the topic-substitution check, efficient mechanistic reasoning alone would merit only the median score; the specific velocity-to-ablation/convergence coupling, which is false of the median proposal, supports the higher score.

reach.justification: The named handle is “belief-state velocity,” paired with a “training-free pruning/early-exit controller” that can stop or compress reasoning before additional tokens are generated, so its strongest use is ex ante rather than merely post-hoc attribution. Although the answer subspace requires per-model extraction, the claimed low-velocity-to-inertness and sustained-decay-to-convergence relations predict what should recur after recalibration rather than supplying only an open-ended search procedure. The asserted scope covers multiple reasoning-task classes and model sizes, and downstream users include inference-system practitioners who gate compute or ship latency-sensitive models, consistent with the practical uptake demonstrated for adaptive-compute systems such as CALM and LayerSkip. The topic-substitution check does not preserve this score: removing the specific measurable signal and controller leaves only generic efficient reasoning, whereas this claim supplies a transferable relation, action window, and concrete deployment knob.
